description: Phase 67 IRIS endpoint selection (already in use). Loopback (127.0.0.1/localhost) is FORBIDDEN by p67-endpoint-validate; the selected endpoint is the docker service name on the shared network, reachable from all Shuffle containers.
shared_network: true — iriswebapp_nginx is on mct-security + shuffle_swarm_executions networks shared with all Shuffle containers
dns_identity: true — DNS name iriswebapp_nginx resolves within the shared docker network to the IRIS nginx service
tls_validated: accepted-pinned — workflow uses verify=False (cert not strictly validated); recorded as a security item to pin/validate (OW-67-01)
rollback_defined: true — Class-A workflow is value-blind; if IRIS endpoint unreachable, execute_python records TARGET_FAILED (no destructive change); no production routing weakened
